# Calculate what values should replace the zeros
def get_horizontal_mirror(row, pos):
    """Get value that should be at pos for horizontal symmetry"""
    return row[23 - pos]

def get_vertical_mirror(r, c):
    """Get value that should be at (r,c) from its vertical mirror"""
    return input_grid[23 - r][c]

# Get replacement values for all zero positions
replacements = {}
for r, c in [(9, 14), (9, 15), (9, 16), 
             (10, 14), (10, 15), (10, 16),
             (11, 14), (11, 15), (11, 16)]:
    
    h_mirror_val = get_horizontal_mirror(input_grid[r], c)
    v_mirror_val = get_vertical_mirror(r, c)
    
    print(f"Row {r}, Col {c}:")
    print(f"  Horizontal mirror (col {23-c}): {input_grid[r][23-c]}")
    print(f"  Vertical mirror (row {23-r}): {input_grid[23-r][c]}")
    replacements[(r,c)] = (h_mirror_val, v_mirror_val)

print("\nConsistency check:")
all_consistent = True
for (r, c), (hv, vv) in replacements.items():
    if hv != vv:
        print(f"Inconsistency at ({r},{c}): H={hv} vs V={vv}")
        all_consistent = False
if all_consistent:
    print("All positions are consistent!")
